items.question: From what point onward does this vidya cease to grant fruit to any practitioner?
premises: A specific temporal starting point is indicated.
This vidya is characterized as fruit-giving.
After that point it gives fruit to no one.
items.inference: Therefore, from that point onward this vidya no longer yields results for anyone.
uncertainties: The referent of the starting point indicated by tataḥ prabhṛti depends on prior context.
items.plain_english: From then on, this vidya gives fruit to no one.
